name: VEFmultiBooking
author: V-IMAGES.com / éric Fabre

sections.description:
One booking plugin for what you actually sell. A cabin by the night, a bed in a dorm, a sled ride at 2 pm, a course with a limited number of seats, a whole stay made of nights and activities: VEFmultiBooking handles them in the same place, without forcing you into a hotel-style model or into one plugin per kind of booking.

You describe what can be booked, when it is available and what it costs. Visitors choose, book and pay on your own pages, in a single form that adapts to what they picked.

Try it before installing: the live demo shows several very different trades, with a booking form you can use (the payment is simulated) and a read-only administration to look around. Nothing you do there is saved.

Examples of use

  • Guest rooms, cabins and gîtes — a price per night, a whole unit or a single bed in a dorm, optional extras such as breakfast.
  • Guided activities — a river descent, a hike, a sled ride: fixed departures, a limited number of places, and a guide who has to be free.
  • Courses and workshops — a pottery workshop or a yoga class, with a limited number of seats and a minimum number of participants.
  • Appointments — a consultation or a treatment of 45 minutes, booked in the free slots of a practitioner and confirmed by you.
  • Rentals — electric bikes by the half-day, a meeting room by the hour, equipment in limited stock.
  • Stays — a room and a spa treatment in the same cart, paid once.

What you can offer

  • Accommodation — rooms, cabins, gîtes, a private unit booked as a whole, or a shared capacity such as 6 beds in a dorm, each bed bookable on its own.
  • Activities and services — rides, lessons, visits, guided tours, rentals, courses: a date and a time, a number of persons, optional extras.
  • Stays — a package of nights and activities from several resources, booked and cancelled as a whole.
  • Activities that need people — a guide, a driver, an instructor: a time slot is offered only while enough people are free to run it.

How it works

  1. Resources — everything that can be booked: an individual unit or a shared capacity.
  2. Availability — recurring rules generate the bookable slots for you; you can still change or close a slot, a unit or a whole period.
  3. Offers — what the customer actually buys: one or several resources, a price, optional extras.
  4. Booking block — one complete module on your page: the visitor ticks an offer and the form adapts to it, up to the payment.

A getting-started guide inside the plugin walks you through these four steps.

Built so that places are never sold twice

Online and manual bookings go through the same capacity engine. A spot is held for a few minutes during checkout, then converted into a confirmed booking, and released if the visitor leaves. The number of places a single visitor can hold at once is limited. You stay in control: you can add, move or cancel any booking by hand, and when you enter one yourself, none of the visitor rules holds you back.

Rules that fit your business

  • Periods — a resource can be made bookable only during certain periods.
  • Prices by category of customer — adult, child, student and so on, or a price by number of persons.
  • Minimum number of persons — an activity can require a minimum, and the bookings wait until it is reached.
  • No place blocked for nothing — an online booking that stays unpaid after the delay you set (30 minutes by default) is cancelled and its places are released.
  • Cancelled bookings leave no personal data behind — after the delay you set (30 days by default), the name, e-mail address and phone number of a customer whose bookings are all cancelled are erased; the bookings stay, without any name.
  • Closing online booking — for a holiday or a season, the form shows your own message instead, and you can still enter bookings by hand.

A simple, modern booking form

  • Dates in a small calendar field where only the days that can be booked are enabled; − and + buttons for numbers.
  • A cart: a visitor can book several offers in one go (a night, then a sled ride), gives their details once, pays once and receives a single e-mail. On an activity with several time slots in the same day, they can tick more than one, each with its own number of persons: every time slot stays a booking of its own, so one of them can be cancelled without touching the others. They are warned, never blocked, when two bookings take place at the same time.
  • Optional extras with five pricing modes, chosen directly in the form.
  • Questions for the visitor, owner validation when you want to approve a booking before it is confirmed, and shared daily limits across several offers.
  • Optionally, buttons to filter the offers by category and a menu to sort them by price or name.
  • It follows your theme: its fonts and heading sizes by default, and it adapts to every screen size.

Payments

Stripe (hosted Checkout page) and PayPal, with separate test and live keys, so you can try the whole flow without charging a card. One currency per site. No card data is stored or handled by the plugin. Without any key, bookings are recorded and you settle the payment with the customer yourself.

For page builders

Native blocks for the block editor, modules for Divi 5 and widgets for Elementor. All three share the same rendering and the same visual settings (colors, corner roundness, spacing, field style, shadows, layout), set per block with the result shown at once. A Style tab sets the default look of the whole site.

Everything you need to run it

  • Dashboard with a getting-started list.
  • Month, week, day and occupancy calendar, with drag-and-drop rescheduling.
  • Bookings and customers, with customizable automatic e-mails to your customers and to you.
  • Help on every screen, a getting-started guide, copyable diagnostic information and a support form.
  • Multilingual sites: the texts you type can be translated with Polylang or WPML.

Your customers’ data, and your own peace of mind

  • Personal data can be exported and erased with the WordPress tools; an erased customer keeps no name, e-mail, phone or address, while the bookings and payments stay as anonymous accounting records. A suggested text for your privacy policy is provided.
  • Booking numbers are long and random, so a confirmation or payment page cannot be reached by guessing a number.
  • Payment confirmations are checked with the signature of Stripe and PayPal.
  • If you ever need help, you can open a support access with a single click: temporary, limited to what support needs, closed whenever you want, and never started without you. You see what it can and cannot do before you open it.

Free or Pro?

The plugin is complete on its own, with no time limit and nothing locked. You can start with it today and add Pro later: what you set up here is used by the Pro as it is. VEFmultiBooking Pro is a separate paid extension that adds what brings in more, saves time or helps you grow, without taking anything away from this plugin:

  • Sell better — pricing rules (season, occupancy, length of stay, family rates), promo codes, deposits and payment schedules.
  • Save time — reminders and scheduled e-mails, a customer portal, a waitlist for full offers.
  • See and grow — statistics and accounting exports, groups with a shared payment schedule.
  • Move your data — import and export of the catalogue, customers, bookings and settings as CSV files, with a check before every import.

Other plugins by V-IMAGES

  • VEFmusic — a free plugin for a band or a musician’s site: audio player, album showcase, show calendar and an automatic press kit. A separate paid extension adds sales and ticketing. More on v-images.com.
  • VEFpressKit — a downloadable press or media kit (PDF and zip) for any activity, with one stable link. More on v-images.com.
  • VEFflipBox — a flip box for Divi 5, the block editor and Elementor. More on v-images.com.
  • VEFdocsKit — PDF tools on your own server: images into PDF, merge, split, reorder and number pages. More on v-images.com.

More about the plugins, and support: v-images.com.

External services

This plugin connects to the following external services.

  • Stripe — only when the site owner enters Stripe keys in Settings. Used to create payment sessions (Checkout Sessions) and refunds through the official API (api.stripe.com). Sent: amount, currency and booking number; no full card data is ever stored or sent by the plugin (the customer pays on a page hosted by Stripe). A Stripe webhook, whose signature is verified, confirms payments. Terms: https://stripe.com/legal — Privacy: https://stripe.com/privacy
  • PayPal — only when the site owner enters PayPal credentials in Settings. Used to create orders and refunds through the official API (api-m.paypal.com, or api-m.sandbox.paypal.com in test mode). A PayPal webhook, verified through PayPal’s official signature verification API, confirms payments. On the booking page, and only when the visitor chooses to pay with PayPal, the official PayPal JavaScript SDK is loaded in the visitor’s browser (www.paypal.com/sdk/js). Terms and privacy: https://www.paypal.com/legalhub
  • Optional free license (V-IMAGES, v-images.com, the plugin’s publisher) — only if you ask for it (VEFmultiBooking > Settings > License): nothing is sent until you fill in the form and tick the consent box. The free license unlocks nothing — the plugin works exactly the same without it; it only lets the publisher send you news and offers, and identify your site when you ask for support. When you register, the following is sent to the V-IMAGES licensing service (REST route /wp-json/vefls/v1/free-license on v-images.com): the email address you typed, the exact consent text you agreed to, your site’s URL, the VEFmultiBooking version and your site’s language. While you are registered, each time you open the License or Dashboard screen the plugin checks the registration status (on each of those screens until you confirm by email, then once a week), sending your license key, your site’s URL and the VEFmultiBooking version. When you unregister, the plugin asks the service to delete your data.
  • Versions published on WordPress.org (api.wordpress.org and downloads.wordpress.org) — only when a site administrator opens the License tab (the public list of versions is read, and kept for 12 hours) or clicks the button of a version and confirms (the file of that version is downloaded). Nothing is sent about you: it is a plain request for the public list or file.
  • Support & feature requests (email) — only when you explicitly fill in and submit the form (VEFmultiBooking > Diagnostic and support tab): your reply-to email address, the subject and message you typed and the diagnostic information shown on that screen (site URL, VEFmultiBooking and VEFmultiBooking Pro versions, WordPress, PHP and MySQL versions, active theme and plugins, free license key if any) are emailed to the publisher at efabre@v-images.com.
  • Support access (email, optional) — only when a site administrator clicks “Open support access” (VEFmultiBooking > Diagnostic and support tab). Nothing happens otherwise. The click creates a time-limited access (24 hours to 7 days) and emails a single-use sign-in link to the publisher at efabre@v-images.com, together with the diagnostic information shown on that screen and the optional message you typed. The access can be closed at any time, ends by itself on the chosen date and is removed when the plugin is deactivated. Only a hash of the key is stored on your site. While the access is open, a conversation between you and the publisher’s support team is kept on your site only, and erased when the access is closed; when you write in it while the publisher is not looking at it, a short email with your message is sent to the same address (at most one every five minutes). A journal of the last 50 events (opening, sign-ins with IP address, closing) is kept in your database, can be emptied at any time from the same screen, and is removed when the plugin is deleted.

These services are provided by V-IMAGES (Eric Fabre): Terms of use, Privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the vefmultibooking folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it, then open the VEFmultiBooking menu.
  3. Follow the Guide tab: create a resource, set its availability, create an offer, add the “VEF Booking” block (or Divi 5 module / Elementor widget) to a page, then enter your Stripe and/or PayPal keys in Settings.
sections.faq:
What can the support team do with a support access?

Only what you chose to open, for the time you chose, and nothing starts without your click. With the default limited rights the support team reads the VEFmultiBooking screens and the diagnostic, looks at the pages of your site and talks with you in the Diagnostic tab. Even with full administrator rights it cannot change your payment settings or keys, manage users, install or edit code, change the site address or the administrator email, or export personal data. The booking screens show your customers’ names and emails while the access is open; they are only looked at to solve your problem. You can close the access at any time, it ends by itself on the date you chose, you receive an email at each sign-in, and the conversation is erased when the access is closed.

How do I export or erase a customer’s data?

Use the WordPress tools: Tools > Export Personal Data or Erase Personal Data, with the customer’s email address. The export gives the customer record, their bookings and their answers. The erasure removes the name, email, phone and address and the answers to the questions; the bookings and their payments are kept without any personal data, because their dates and amounts are accounting records.

Do I need a license or an account?

No. The plugin is free and complete. An optional free license is offered on the License tab: it unlocks nothing and changes nothing in the plugin, it only lets the publisher keep in touch with you (news, offers) and answer support requests faster.

What does VEFmultiBooking Pro add?

Pro is a separate paid extension. It adds pricing rules (season, occupancy, length of stay, family rates), promo codes, deposits and payment schedules, reminders and scheduled e-mails, a customer portal, a waitlist, statistics with accounting exports and groups with a shared payment schedule. Everything in this plugin stays free and keeps working without it. The About tab presents the publisher and its other plugins.

Which page builders are supported?

The WordPress block editor, Divi 5 and Elementor. No shortcode is needed.

Can I use several currencies?

One currency per site, set in Settings before taking real bookings. Prices are never converted between currencies.

Can I test payments without charging a card?

Yes: enter your Stripe test keys and/or PayPal sandbox credentials and keep the test mode selected.

Can I have a feature added, or a custom plugin built?

V-IMAGES also develops custom WordPress plugins and can adapt its own plugins to your needs: a change to an existing plugin, a block, a module or a widget, or a complete plugin. Every request is considered, and every project is quoted individually. You can describe what you need on the custom development page.
sections.changelog:
1.9.2

  • Fixed: in the Divi 5 Booking module, the “Offers proposed” list (used when a visitor adds another offer) was empty, so the offers to propose could not be chosen. All the published offers are now listed and ticked; untick the ones that must not be offered.
  • Fixed: the “Success color” setting of the Divi 5 Booking summary module was missing in the Visual Builder.

1.9.1

  • New: a License tab in Settings: free registration in one click, with a discount code for VEFmultiBooking Pro, and a list of the versions published on WordPress.org to go back to an earlier one.
  • Changed: the About tab is shorter and presents V-IMAGES and its other plugins. VEFmultiBooking Pro is presented there by a single discreet card.

1.9.0

  • New: each offer can have its own words in the booking form, the cart and the confirmation. In the offer, section “Wording and team”: the word for the number of people (“Number of pieces”, “Quantity”…) and the word shown before the person who leads the activity (“With”, “Guide”…). Left empty, the usual wording stays. An offer with its own word for the people also says “3 left” instead of “3 spots left”.
  • New: each offer can have its own choice of what customers see of the people who run it: nothing, who leads the activity, or who leads it and a choice of the person. By default an offer follows the Staff tab, as before. An escape game can hide the people while a guided tour offers them, on the same site and even on the same activity.
  • Fixed: an offer with a free price category (a free child price, for example) no longer reads “From 0.00 EUR”: the free category is ignored in the “from” price, and an offer that is entirely free reads “Free”.
  • Fixed: the message shown when too many bookings are started with the same e-mail address (five per hour) said that a few minutes were enough. It now tells how long to wait. The limits can be changed with the vefmb_rate_limits filter.
  • The database is updated automatically (three settings for each offer).

1.8.1

  • Changed: the icons of the administration screens (set-up checklist, offers, resources, Guide, free license) are WordPress Dashicons instead of emoji.
  • New: a “Need something custom?” section in the Licenses and versions tab and in the FAQ, with a link to the custom development page.
  • The code comments are in English and the code is tidied. No change of behavior.

1.8.0

  • New: an optional product of an offer that sells nights and activities can be charged on top of the price of the offer. Enter the extra price on the product, in the resources of the offer (Offers tab of the Catalogue), and choose how it is counted: per session, or per person and per session. Empty means included, as before. A guest who books ten sessions now pays ten supplements. The price shown while choosing, the cart, the confirmation, the e-mails and the booking detail show one line per supplement with the number of times it is counted, and a promo code applies to the total with the supplements.
  • Fixed: moving a booking to another day in the calendar is refused when nobody who runs the activity is free that day, and the new departure now gets its people.
  • Fixed: on a departure that gives one person to each customer, the people stay busy after a customer has left (booking cancelled or not completed in time) until the next booking of the departure, so nobody can be taken for another activity at the same time.
  • The database is updated automatically (an extra price and the way it is counted, for each product of an offer).

1.7.5

  • Fixed: in an offer that sells nights and activities, when a customer books several sessions of an activity, a person chosen for one session is no longer offered for another session that takes place at the same time.
  • Fixed: a second session can use the same time as the first one, for another guest, as long as the activity has places left (a massage with a capacity of 2 booked for two guests, for example). The places and the people of all the sessions of an order are now counted together, so a time can no longer be over-booked. The times that the other sessions leave no room for are shown greyed out.

1.7.4

  • New: in an offer that sells nights and activities, customers can choose the person who leads each activity (a masseuse, a ski instructor…) when the Staff tab is set to “Show who leads it, and let customers choose the person”. The choice is checked again when the places are held; with any other setting nothing changes.
  • Fixed: in an offer that sells nights and activities, a product marked “Optional” can now be left out: the order is no longer refused for lack of a day and a time for it. The activity is shown with “(optional)”; if the visitor starts it (a day chosen), a time must be chosen too, or the day cleared. The same applies when a booking is entered by hand in the administration.

1.7.3

  • Fixed: after emptying “Bookings and customers” in Settings, the places those bookings had taken are given back to the opening times and activities, so the remaining places and the planning are right again.
  • Fixed: the line of a promo code in the price details of a booking (confirmation screen, e-mails and administration) is no longer shown under the name of an option: it has its own line.
  • Fixed: on a narrow screen, the price of an offer no longer runs out of its card, and a long offer name stays beside its button.

1.7.2

  • New: in the detail of a booking that belongs to an order of several offers, you can record a manual payment for the whole order and mark the whole order completed in one action each, instead of one booking at a time.
  • Fixed: a partially paid booking shows “Partially paid” instead of an internal code, in the list and in the detail of bookings.

1.7.1

short_description: Booking engine for rooms, dorm beds, activities and time slots, with Stripe and PayPal, no double booking. Block editor, Divi 5 and Elementor.
description:
One booking plugin for what you actually sell. A cabin by the night, a bed in a dorm, a sled ride at 2 pm, a course with a limited number of seats, a whole stay made of nights and activities: VEFmultiBooking handles them in the same place, without forcing you into a hotel-style model or into one plugin per kind of booking.

You describe what can be booked, when it is available and what it costs. Visitors choose, book and pay on your own pages, in a single form that adapts to what they picked.

Try it before installing: the live demo shows several very different trades, with a booking form you can use (the payment is simulated) and a read-only administration to look around. Nothing you do there is saved.

Examples of use

  • Guest rooms, cabins and gîtes — a price per night, a whole unit or a single bed in a dorm, optional extras such as breakfast.
  • Guided activities — a river descent, a hike, a sled ride: fixed departures, a limited number of places, and a guide who has to be free.
  • Courses and workshops — a pottery workshop or a yoga class, with a limited number of seats and a minimum number of participants.
  • Appointments — a consultation or a treatment of 45 minutes, booked in the free slots of a practitioner and confirmed by you.
  • Rentals — electric bikes by the half-day, a meeting room by the hour, equipment in limited stock.
  • Stays — a room and a spa treatment in the same cart, paid once.

What you can offer

  • Accommodation — rooms, cabins, gîtes, a private unit booked as a whole, or a shared capacity such as 6 beds in a dorm, each bed bookable on its own.
  • Activities and services — rides, lessons, visits, guided tours, rentals, courses: a date and a time, a number of persons, optional extras.
  • Stays — a package of nights and activities from several resources, booked and cancelled as a whole.
  • Activities that need people — a guide, a driver, an instructor: a time slot is offered only while enough people are free to run it.

How it works

  1. Resources — everything that can be booked: an individual unit or a shared capacity.
  2. Availability — recurring rules generate the bookable slots for you; you can still change or close a slot, a unit or a whole period.
  3. Offers — what the customer actually buys: one or several resources, a price, optional extras.
  4. Booking block — one complete module on your page: the visitor ticks an offer and the form adapts to it, up to the payment.

A getting-started guide inside the plugin walks you through these four steps.

Built so that places are never sold twice

Online and manual bookings go through the same capacity engine. A spot is held for a few minutes during checkout, then converted into a confirmed booking, and released if the visitor leaves. The number of places a single visitor can hold at once is limited. You stay in control: you can add, move or cancel any booking by hand, and when you enter one yourself, none of the visitor rules holds you back.

Rules that fit your business

  • Periods — a resource can be made bookable only during certain periods.
  • Prices by category of customer — adult, child, student and so on, or a price by number of persons.
  • Minimum number of persons — an activity can require a minimum, and the bookings wait until it is reached.
  • No place blocked for nothing — an online booking that stays unpaid after the delay you set (30 minutes by default) is cancelled and its places are released.
  • Cancelled bookings leave no personal data behind — after the delay you set (30 days by default), the name, e-mail address and phone number of a customer whose bookings are all cancelled are erased; the bookings stay, without any name.
  • Closing online booking — for a holiday or a season, the form shows your own message instead, and you can still enter bookings by hand.

A simple, modern booking form

  • Dates in a small calendar field where only the days that can be booked are enabled; − and + buttons for numbers.
  • A cart: a visitor can book several offers in one go (a night, then a sled ride), gives their details once, pays once and receives a single e-mail. On an activity with several time slots in the same day, they can tick more than one, each with its own number of persons: every time slot stays a booking of its own, so one of them can be cancelled without touching the others. They are warned, never blocked, when two bookings take place at the same time.
  • Optional extras with five pricing modes, chosen directly in the form.
  • Questions for the visitor, owner validation when you want to approve a booking before it is confirmed, and shared daily limits across several offers.
  • Optionally, buttons to filter the offers by category and a menu to sort them by price or name.
  • It follows your theme: its fonts and heading sizes by default, and it adapts to every screen size.

Payments

Stripe (hosted Checkout page) and PayPal, with separate test and live keys, so you can try the whole flow without charging a card. One currency per site. No card data is stored or handled by the plugin. Without any key, bookings are recorded and you settle the payment with the customer yourself.

For page builders

Native blocks for the block editor, modules for Divi 5 and widgets for Elementor. All three share the same rendering and the same visual settings (colors, corner roundness, spacing, field style, shadows, layout), set per block with the result shown at once. A Style tab sets the default look of the whole site.

Everything you need to run it

  • Dashboard with a getting-started list.
  • Month, week, day and occupancy calendar, with drag-and-drop rescheduling.
  • Bookings and customers, with customizable automatic e-mails to your customers and to you.
  • Help on every screen, a getting-started guide, copyable diagnostic information and a support form.
  • Multilingual sites: the texts you type can be translated with Polylang or WPML.

Your customers’ data, and your own peace of mind

  • Personal data can be exported and erased with the WordPress tools; an erased customer keeps no name, e-mail, phone or address, while the bookings and payments stay as anonymous accounting records. A suggested text for your privacy policy is provided.
  • Booking numbers are long and random, so a confirmation or payment page cannot be reached by guessing a number.
  • Payment confirmations are checked with the signature of Stripe and PayPal.
  • If you ever need help, you can open a support access with a single click: temporary, limited to what support needs, closed whenever you want, and never started without you. You see what it can and cannot do before you open it.

Free or Pro?

The plugin is complete on its own, with no time limit and nothing locked. You can start with it today and add Pro later: what you set up here is used by the Pro as it is. VEFmultiBooking Pro is a separate paid extension that adds what brings in more, saves time or helps you grow, without taking anything away from this plugin:

  • Sell better — pricing rules (season, occupancy, length of stay, family rates), promo codes, deposits and payment schedules.
  • Save time — reminders and scheduled e-mails, a customer portal, a waitlist for full offers.
  • See and grow — statistics and accounting exports, groups with a shared payment schedule.
  • Move your data — import and export of the catalogue, customers, bookings and settings as CSV files, with a check before every import.

Other plugins by V-IMAGES

  • VEFmusic — a free plugin for a band or a musician’s site: audio player, album showcase, show calendar and an automatic press kit. A separate paid extension adds sales and ticketing. More on v-images.com.
  • VEFpressKit — a downloadable press or media kit (PDF and zip) for any activity, with one stable link. More on v-images.com.
  • VEFflipBox — a flip box for Divi 5, the block editor and Elementor. More on v-images.com.
  • VEFdocsKit — PDF tools on your own server: images into PDF, merge, split, reorder and number pages. More on v-images.com.

More about the plugins, and support: v-images.com.

External services

This plugin connects to the following external services.

  • Stripe — only when the site owner enters Stripe keys in Settings. Used to create payment sessions (Checkout Sessions) and refunds through the official API (api.stripe.com). Sent: amount, currency and booking number; no full card data is ever stored or sent by the plugin (the customer pays on a page hosted by Stripe). A Stripe webhook, whose signature is verified, confirms payments. Terms: https://stripe.com/legal — Privacy: https://stripe.com/privacy
  • PayPal — only when the site owner enters PayPal credentials in Settings. Used to create orders and refunds through the official API (api-m.paypal.com, or api-m.sandbox.paypal.com in test mode). A PayPal webhook, verified through PayPal’s official signature verification API, confirms payments. On the booking page, and only when the visitor chooses to pay with PayPal, the official PayPal JavaScript SDK is loaded in the visitor’s browser (www.paypal.com/sdk/js). Terms and privacy: https://www.paypal.com/legalhub
  • Optional free license (V-IMAGES, v-images.com, the plugin’s publisher) — only if you ask for it (VEFmultiBooking > Settings > License): nothing is sent until you fill in the form and tick the consent box. The free license unlocks nothing — the plugin works exactly the same without it; it only lets the publisher send you news and offers, and identify your site when you ask for support. When you register, the following is sent to the V-IMAGES licensing service (REST route /wp-json/vefls/v1/free-license on v-images.com): the email address you typed, the exact consent text you agreed to, your site’s URL, the VEFmultiBooking version and your site’s language. While you are registered, each time you open the License or Dashboard screen the plugin checks the registration status (on each of those screens until you confirm by email, then once a week), sending your license key, your site’s URL and the VEFmultiBooking version. When you unregister, the plugin asks the service to delete your data.
  • Versions published on WordPress.org (api.wordpress.org and downloads.wordpress.org) — only when a site administrator opens the License tab (the public list of versions is read, and kept for 12 hours) or clicks the button of a version and confirms (the file of that version is downloaded). Nothing is sent about you: it is a plain request for the public list or file.
  • Support & feature requests (email) — only when you explicitly fill in and submit the form (VEFmultiBooking > Diagnostic and support tab): your reply-to email address, the subject and message you typed and the diagnostic information shown on that screen (site URL, VEFmultiBooking and VEFmultiBooking Pro versions, WordPress, PHP and MySQL versions, active theme and plugins, free license key if any) are emailed to the publisher at efabre@v-images.com.
  • Support access (email, optional) — only when a site administrator clicks “Open support access” (VEFmultiBooking > Diagnostic and support tab). Nothing happens otherwise. The click creates a time-limited access (24 hours to 7 days) and emails a single-use sign-in link to the publisher at efabre@v-images.com, together with the diagnostic information shown on that screen and the optional message you typed. The access can be closed at any time, ends by itself on the chosen date and is removed when the plugin is deactivated. Only a hash of the key is stored on your site. While the access is open, a conversation between you and the publisher’s support team is kept on your site only, and erased when the access is closed; when you write in it while the publisher is not looking at it, a short email with your message is sent to the same address (at most one every five minutes). A journal of the last 50 events (opening, sign-ins with IP address, closing) is kept in your database, can be emptied at any time from the same screen, and is removed when the plugin is deleted.

These services are provided by V-IMAGES (Eric Fabre): Terms of use, Privacy policy.
